workLog.summary: Confirmed both defects against the shipped workflow. The MUST regex targets markdown table rows; grep -c '"|"' scripts/validate_session_json.py returns 0, so the pattern can never match. Found a third defect while reading: validation-result.md is written twice in a row, so the markdown-wrapped first write is dead.

Added --json-output to validate_session_json.py emitting verdict, must_failures, error_count, errors and warnings. Routed the three MUST error shapes through module constants shared by the emit sites and count_must_failures so the count cannot drift from the messages. Rewired the workflow counter to read the summary, echoed findings into a collapsible group on the failure path, and dropped the dead write.

181 passed. Four pwsh tests execute the counter block sliced out of the shipped workflow, including the four-failure case the old regex could never reach. Negative controls: restoring the phantom regex turns 4 tests red, dropping the echo turns 1 red, restoring the double write turns 1 red. Confirmed --pre-commit and the no-flag callers are unaffected.

nextSteps: Watch the first CI run that fails session validation and confirm the findings appear in the job log.
